newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech police detain 25 bank fraud suspects - CTK.
newsitem.headline: Czech police detain 25 bank fraud suspects - CTK.

text.p: Czech police have detained a total of 25 people suspected of involvement in defrauding 10 banks from 1992 to 1994, the Czech CTK agency quoted an interior ministry spokesman as saying.
It quoted the spokesman, Jan Subert, as saying that the people were arrested in various places around the country and accused of fraud causing major damages.
He said among those accused were entreprenuers, former soldiers, former policemen, and former prison guards.
The report did not indicate which banks were affected or the total amount of the damages, nor did it say the method by which the fraud was carried out.
Subert was not immediately available for further comment.
